title: Devious Minds
start: Talk to the monk just outside Paterdomus (the temple on the Salve).

items.t: Mithril 2h sword (Mithril 2h sword +1, +2 variants will not work)
A large pouch (must be able to hold 9 essence, will be lost during the quest)

recommended.t: An invitation box for quick teleports to the monk (requires completion of the Missing, Presumed Death quest) or activated Fort Forinthry lodestone (requires completion of New Foundations quest)
A law altar teleport for easy access to Entrana, or access to the Abyss
25,000 coins, and 50 Runecrafting for Runecrafting Guild access, if you wish to buy a large pouch instead of getting it from monster drops

steps.t: Talk to the monk just outside of Paterdomus which is east of Silvarea. [Chat: Accept]
Head to Doric's hut north of the Falador lodestone and use a mithril 2h sword on the whetstone outside of the hut.
Use a bowstring on the slender blade.
Return to the monk. [Chat: 1 Yep, got it right here for you.]
Use the orb on a large pouch.
Bank everything that you are not allowed to take to Entrana, and ensure you keep the large pouch in your inventory.
Reach Entrana either through the Abyss or by using a law altar teleport.

sub.t: If entering through the Abyss, enter the Abyss via the Mage of Zamorak north of Edgeville, then make your way to the law rift. Dismiss any summoning familiar. Leave the Law Rune Temple by using the portal.

steps.t: Head into the church of Entrana to the south.
Use the pouch on the prayer altar. Doing this will cause you to lose your large pouch.

sub.t: Talk to the High Priest if you didn't during the cutscene.

steps.t: Return to the monk, back outside Paterdomus.
Talk to the High Priest back on Entrana.
Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.

sub.t: [Chat: 2 Devious Minds] if The Slug Menace has not yet been started.
